status: DECLARED, to be checked against the exchange's published roll schedule before the clock starts
rule: Roll date of a listed contract = n_bdays business days before its anchor date. The reference contract on trade date d is the first listed contract whose roll date is after d. A due roll executes at the settlement of the first processed trade date on or after the roll date at which both contracts have a settlement (two fills per contract, D8 costs). A roll still pending on or after the held contract's anchor date is flagged roll_overdue.
business_days: Monday to Friday; exchange holidays NOT modelled (declared approximation, UNSOURCED). The operator's pre-clock check compares forward.rolls.roll_schedule output with the exchange's published calendar.
quotes: verbatim from the saved files, whitespace-normalised (table cells joined with ' | ')
contract_id_format: root + month code (FGHJKMNQUVXZ) + 2-digit year, e.g. MNQZ26; a label the operator enters prices against

W-CL.what: Wayback capture of NYMEX Light Sweet Crude contract specifications
W-CL.quote: Trading in the current delivery month shall cease on the third business day prior to the twenty-fifth calendar day of the month preceding the delivery month.

W-GC.what: Wayback capture of COMEX Gold contract specifications

W-NG.what: Wayback capture of NYMEX Henry Hub Natural Gas contract specifications
W-NG.quote: Trading of any delivery month shall cease three (3) business days prior to the first day of the delivery month.

W-ZC.what: Wayback capture of CBOT Corn contract specifications
W-ZC.quote: Termination Of Trading The business day prior to the 15th calendar day of the contract month.

counts_py.what: the program's own roll estimate for blackout counting
counts_py.quote: equity and FX on the contract month's third Friday minus 8 days, every other product on the 5th-last trade date of the month before each listed month
